scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Grant to the Institutions for Long Term Project in the Field of Art and Culture (Sarjansheel Goa)
other_conditions: Institution must be registered under the Society’s Registration Act, 1860 or Indian Trust Act
Institution must be involved in long‑term projects in the field of Art and Culture
Individual must be from the Goan community and have resided in Goa for at least 15 years
Individual must be involved in a long‑term project in the field of Art and Culture and have contributed at least 15 years in the relevant field
benefits_summary: Grant covering up to 80% of project expenditure, capped at ₹5,00,000 per annum.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
